levels.label: Partial remediation handoff
levels.allowed_claim: A canvas can keep stable finding references, human intent, mixed dispositions, and a next action together.
levels.forbidden_inference: The finding has been fixed or verified automatically.

levels.label: Source authority
levels.allowed_claim: The local canvas records Quality Lens reference IDs and producer identity without copying the authoritative payload.
levels.forbidden_inference: The canvas is a second authoritative finding store.

levels.label: Stale refresh
levels.allowed_claim: A changed finding set marks the canvas stale while preserving the prior partial work.
levels.forbidden_inference: The old plan still represents the current source set.

levels.label: Cross-tool handoff
levels.allowed_claim: The receipt leaves a seam for downstream source-authority and review handoff.
levels.forbidden_inference: Quality Lens or Review Attention Map has consumed this exact canvas.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The canvas case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
